name: Troisdorf (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and red in the proportions 1:5:1, charged at the centre with the city arms of Troisdorf (a T-shaped figure with discs on white).
history: Municipal flag of Troisdorf; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Troisdorf arms — T-shaped figure with discs on white
